query_types.label: Billing & Payments
steps: Open Settings → Billing to see your current plan and payment method.
Download any invoice from the Invoices tab (PDF, includes tax details).
To change cards, choose Update payment method and re-enter your details.
Duplicate or unexpected charges usually clear within 3-5 business days.

sub_topics.label: I was charged twice
steps: Check the Invoices tab for two entries on the same date.
Pending authorisations often drop off within 3-5 business days.
If both invoices are settled, we'll refund the duplicate in full.

sub_topics.label: Update my payment method
steps: Go to Settings → Billing → Payment method.
Add the new card, then set it as default.
Remove the old card once the next invoice succeeds.

query_types.label: Orders & Shipping
steps: Open My Orders and select the order you want to check.
Use Track shipment for live courier updates and the delivery window.
Orders ship within 1-2 business days; delivery takes 3-7 days.
If tracking hasn't moved for 5 days, we'll open an investigation with the courier.

sub_topics.label: Track my order
steps: Open My Orders and select the order you want to track.
Copy the tracking number and open the carrier's tracking page.
Check the Estimated Delivery field for the expected date.
Enable order notifications to get status updates by email or SMS.

sub_topics.label: My order is late
steps: Confirm the expected window on the order page.
Check for a delivery attempt notice from the courier.
If it's more than 3 days late, we'll reship or refund.

query_types.label: Returns & Refunds
steps: Sign in and open My Orders, then select the item you want to return.
Click Return or exchange and choose a reason for the return.
Print the prepaid return label and pack the item in its original packaging.
Drop the package at the carrier and keep your receipt.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

sub_topics.label: Start a return or exchange
steps: Open My Orders → Return or exchange.
Choose refund or replacement.
Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery.

sub_topics.label: Item arrived damaged
steps: Photograph the item and the outer packaging.
Start a return and select Arrived damaged, attaching the photos.
We ship a replacement immediately — no need to return first.

query_types.label: Account & Login
steps: Use Forgot password on the sign-in screen — the reset link is valid for 30 minutes.
Check spam and promotions folders if the email hasn't arrived within 2 minutes.
Accounts lock after 5 failed attempts and unlock automatically after 15 minutes.
To change your email, confirm the new address from Settings → Profile.

sub_topics.label: I can't reset my password
steps: Request a fresh link — older links expire after 30 minutes.
Make sure you're using the email on the account.
Still stuck? A human can verify your identity manually.

sub_topics.label: I'm locked out of my account
steps: Confirm you're using the correct email and password.
If 2FA is blocking you, use a backup recovery code from when you set it up.
If you've lost your 2FA device and codes, request identity verification.
We'll help you regain access after verifying your identity.

query_types.label: Technical Support
steps: Hard-refresh the page or restart the app to clear stale state.
Try an incognito window with extensions disabled.
Note the exact error text and what you were doing right before it.
Check our status page for any active incident.

sub_topics.label: Report a bug
steps: Capture a screenshot or short screen recording.
Note your browser or device and OS version.
Send it through and an engineer will pick it up.

sub_topics.label: Something is slow or won't load
steps: Check your internet connection and run a quick speed test.
Clear the cache and disable browser extensions that might interfere.
Try an incognito/private window to rule out cached data.
If the issue is widespread, check our status page for any ongoing outage.

query_types.label: Product Info
steps: Every product page lists full specs, materials and compatibility.
Compare plans side by side from the Pricing page.
Stock notifications are available on out-of-stock items.
Bulk and team pricing starts at 10 seats or units.

sub_topics.label: Features & how to use it
steps: Open the product page and read the Features tab.
Watch the linked getting-started tutorial video.
Follow the step-by-step setup guide in the Help Center.
Bookmark the documentation for quick reference later.

sub_topics.label: Compatibility & specs
steps: Open the Specifications tab on the product page.
Compare the listed requirements with your device or system.
Check the Compatibility notes for known integrations.
Review the warranty terms before purchase.

query_types.label: Other / Something else
steps: Describe your question in your own words — I'll match it to the right team.
If I'm not confident, I'll hand you to a human expert straight away.
You can ask for a human at any point in the conversation.
